title: Direct Contents search finds no exact R-192 QFT production-owner fields
question: Does the configured canonical Contents source root contain an exact current QFT production owner for the R-192 heat/root, filtration, replica, raw-current and q-ledger slots beyond the selected legacy index?
method: Run case-insensitive fixed-string rg searches over the configured Contents source root for heat_root_incidence, root filtration, conditional replicas, raw-current spatial intertwiner, q-ledger, mobility, production generator, and stochastic quantization.
Run bounded discovery searches for Langevin, Gaussian-Hartree and Model A to identify legacy comparison material without treating hits as current authorities.
Compare every exact-token result and representative discovery source against the hash-pinned A1/R-192 owner contract and record only owner-complete matches as admissible.
finding: The direct canonical Contents root contains zero files matching each of the eight exact R-192 owner-field strings. Broad searches do find legacy Langevin, Gaussian-Hartree and Model-A material, but no returned source supplies the current complex three-component A1 production generator and mobility together with heat_root_incidence, root-labelled filtration, conditional replicas, raw-current spatial intertwining and a once-owned nonnegative q-ledger. The direct source search therefore strengthens the bounded R-192 blocker while leaving open the possibility of a future source using different terminology or an unindexed external authority.
decision_reason: Exact owner fields are load-bearing and cannot be inferred from generic QFT vocabulary. Importing a Model-A, Hartree or Langevin hit would change the kinetic law, field space, regulator or normalization and would bypass the R-192 first-failure contract. The correct disposition is a bounded applicability stop, not a global no-go theorem.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing direct-Contents source search only. It does not prove global source absence, refute a future QFT construction, close R-192/R-193, supply A13/T-050, establish an interacting measure, OS/KMS or real-time dynamics, select a physical vacuum, or close Sector-A, Pre-A, physical-empty, thermodynamic, continuum or removal routes.
next_action: Keep all generic QFT discovery material quarantined. Advance only when a stable authority supplies a terminology-resolved and hash-pinned A1 production generator/mobility, heat_root_incidence, root filtration, conditional replicas, raw-current spatial identity and one-use nonnegative q-ledger; then rerun the unchanged R-192 owner order.
